title: jumbo recipes cards
text: jumbo recipes cards. I purchased the bamboo version as is bamboo is renewable.  That part is fine.  But the "functioning lock" is really silly PLUS - there was no key - so that sort of takes away the "functioning" part.  I wouldn't be locking my recipes anyway.  But they really need to update that on the ad.  It comes with some recipe cards and dividers.  I have an overstuffed, too small card box so I thought I'd try this one.  It seems sturdy- time will tell.

product_metadata.title: Pinelive 700+ Locking Large Recipe Box with Cards and Dividers PLUS Phone/iPad Holder. 152 Index Recipe Cards 4x6, 16 Dividers and Measurements in Recipe Card Box. Pine Wooden Recipe Box (Bamboo)
features: ONLY FOR SERIOUS RECIPE LOVERS: With space inside for over 700 Recipes, and slots on top for 4 recipe cards and TWO cellphones (or iPad), this recipe organizer is for those who ADORE cooking feasts and LOVE recipes in an ABUNDANT way! Perhaps you’ve got too many? And that’s ok too, because when it’s time to declutter… this recipe keeper with 152 Index Cards AND 16 Dividers is also built for YOU!

EXACTLY HOW MUCH DOES IT FIT? The entire wood box is 13.6” across and 6.9” deep. It features a middle wood divider, so you can fit 350+ recipe cards on each side. Inside, your box is 5.3” tall, and we all know that’s plenty of room for those tab divider cards, 4x6 recipe cards, 3x5 recipe cards, notebook pages folded up, and even all those special recipes you have sellotaped in plastic or laminated.

KEEP THEM CLEAN, AS YOU COOK: At the start of your kitchen extravaganza you can pop 4 recipe cards into the handy 1/16” recipe holder. Entrée, Main, Sauce and Dessert all at your fingertips. And the 0.86” slot lets you access everything else (room for 2 phones or a 12.9” iPad)! There’s no need to touch your recipes with sticky hands until you’re all done, and cleaned up – pristine and preserved.

RECIPE CARDS AND LOCKING BOX GIFT SET: Not only is the 700+ Farmhouse Recipe Box the largest you’ve seen, it’s a total gift set too. It comes with 152x double-sided recipe cards, 16x Recipe Card Dividers with tabs and 1x handy conversion card for “good measure”. You (or whoever you’re gifting it to) can personalize their categories to what works best, because the dividers feature blank tabs to write on.

BIG, STRONG AND BEAUTIFUL: Durable construction (your box is firmly nailed AND glued for long term sturdiness) and the most space you can imagine, this is a heavy duty recipe box, for those who love living the heavy duty recipe life! It also comes with a 30-Day Money Back Guarantee, so why not try it now and fill it up with your most delicious secrets!
